meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 用户要求重构时,Claude 会先弄清楚目标和范围(不清楚就提问),再检查受影响的代码和测试情况,列出计划后一步步改,每步跑测试,最后确认没弄坏功能并汇报改动。
howto.when: 当用户要求重构、简化或抽取代码等,或使用 /refactor 命令时。

say.text: 重构 src/auth/handler.ts,并按模块拆分。
say.note: 它会分析该文件的依赖与测试覆盖后再动手。

say.text: 把 AuthService 类改小,先出计划再执行。
say.note: 它会先展示计划,确认后再改。

say.text: 将整个项目里所有过期 API 调用迁移到新版本。
say.note: 测试不足时它会停下,让你选择是否先补测试。

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor, Claude confirms goal and scope, asking if unclear; maps dependencies and test coverage; drafts a plan; applies stepwise changes with tests after each step; checks nothing is broken; lists changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to refactor, simplify, or extract code (etc.), or uses the /refactor command.

say_en.text: Refactor src/auth/handler.ts, splitting it by modules.
say_en.note: It analyzes the file's dependencies and test coverage before editing.

say_en.text: Make the AuthService class smaller—plan first, then execute.
say_en.note: It presents a plan and waits for your confirmation.

say_en.text: Migrate all deprecated API calls across the whole project to the new version.
say_en.note: If coverage is low, it stops and asks whether to add tests first.
